# griot

> Research a subject and write a spoken commentary script for it — reusable writers for braidio productions


## Pages in this subsection

- [griot](griot.html.md): griot — research a subject, then write the spoken commentary about it.
- [griot.dossier](griot.dossier.html.md): The dossier — what research found, in one record the writer reads.
- [griot.gates](griot.gates.html.md): Gates — what a draft must pass before it is voiced, and what it failed.
- [griot.style](griot.style.html.md): The style library — the voice guide, the checklist, twenty critic voices.
- [griot.tools](griot.tools.html.md): The SSOT verbs — plain functions, JSON-able in, JSON-able out.
- [griot.writers](griot.writers.html.md): Writers — reusable, parametrized authors of spoken commentary.
